general_information.Syllabus Name: Science of Color_Khoa học màu sắc
general_information.Description: After completing the course of color science, students can master and apply The Experience of Color / Color Awareness / The Uses of Color / Color-Order Systems / Color Study in their design work. The course focuses on color theory, operation and influence of color in diverse areas of design and user experience. Besides, the subject supports students to form creative ability and arrange layout to form a balanced and coherent whole for the composition. Enhance the perception of backgrounds, colors, layouts and applications in specific decorative products. In addition, the subject helps students practice independent working habits and self-arrange personal work plans. Develop creative thinking ability through the diverse expression of ideas as the foundation for the project system in the following semesters. In addition, form an attitude of being willing to learn and develop yourself when given the opportunity.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination 2. Actively participate in class activities 3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class 4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose 5. Read the textbook in advance 6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course. 7. Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submlit to the teacher 01 day after the course.
general_information.Tools: Individual tools prepared by students: - 1 folder (size A2). - Paper (size A3, A4), A1 backboard paper. - Color, pencil, eraser, brushes, back ink pen. - Ruler, paper knife, scissors, paper sticking-plaster, double sized tape, glue. - Laptop

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Recognize the relationship between colors and factors related to reading comprehension and analysis, creating meaning for colors
Define and explain color through the connection between 3 properties of color: Hue, Value, Saturation.

Detected Color instability by looking at color composition, Ground and Carried Colors, Placement and Color Change, Equilibrium, Simultaneous Contrast, Afterimage and Contrast Reversal, Complementary Contrast. Then, know how to apply this instability to the design to actively decide the outcome of the product.
Manage the Color Illusions, The Illusion of Depth, Spatial Effects of Colors, Transparence Illusion, Fluting, Vibration, Vanishing Boundaries, Luminosity, Bezold Effect, Optical Mixes
Construct and Organize the color in line with modern trends through understanding the history and theory of color.
Create color harmony in design products
Applying color and light in media and commercial design, interaction design and graphics-related fields
Having a professional style in design activities. Love to research and perfect themselvs in visual arts.
